headline: High: Notion AI can ingest shared workspace content while Airbyte has broad egress, creating a default-path data leakage and cascading-error risk.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Airbyte has no documented inbound channel from Notion AI, and Notion AI is RAG-style over workspace content rather than a raw instruction bridge. The only plausible pathway is manual copy/paste or shared workspace text, so prompt injection is possible but not default and blast radius is limited. Both profiles lack a direct shared parser channel.
conditions: IF an operator copies Notion AI output into Airbyte prompts or configs
IF shared workspace text is treated as instructions by Airbyte
mitigations: Use a strict copy/paste policy for any AI-generated text
Prefix pasted content with a human-authored instruction boundary
Review Airbyte inputs before execution
Disable any workflow that auto-ingests Notion text into Airbyte
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging between systems

B_data_leakage.rationale: Notion AI can access pages and databases in the user's workspace, while Airbyte has broad network egress and touches business data. If workspace content is moved into Airbyte pipelines or Airbyte outputs are summarized in Notion, sensitive business data can leave the workspace and reach vendor backends. The pair creates a realistic default-path leakage risk through shared content handling.
conditions: IF Notion pages containing sensitive business data are used as Airbyte inputs
IF Airbyte outputs are copied back into Notion AI for summarization or Q&A
mitigations: Restrict Airbyte sources to non-sensitive datasets
Mark sensitive Notion pages as off-limits for pipeline inputs
Review destination connectors for external egress
Use separate workspaces for sensitive and non-sensitive content
requires-engineering: enforce data-class filters between Notion and Airbyte

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Airbyte can call APIs and has broad egress, while Notion AI operates on shared workspace state across instances. Even though Notion AI cannot write the host filesystem, both can mutate shared business content through different surfaces, so overlapping writes can race or overwrite each other. The conflict is plausible in default collaborative use, though not as severe as unrestricted filesystem contention.
conditions: IF Airbyte writes records that Notion AI also edits in the same workspace
IF multiple Notion AI instances and Airbyte-driven automations target the same pages or databases
mitigations: Assign one system as the source of truth per dataset
Lock shared pages during automated updates
Schedule Airbyte syncs outside active editing windows
Review conflicting edits before publishing
requires-engineering: add optimistic concurrency controls

D_cascading_error.rationale: Notion AI is a workspace Q&A and summarization layer, so it may present Airbyte-produced facts as authoritative if those outputs are pasted or synced into pages. Airbyte can generate downstream data artifacts that Notion AI then rephrases without verification. This creates a default-path cascade from pipeline output into user-facing knowledge, with moderate blast radius across multiple work products.
conditions: IF Airbyte outputs are imported into Notion pages without human review
IF Notion AI is asked to summarize Airbyte-generated reports as facts
mitigations: Require human review before publishing synced outputs
Label Airbyte-derived content as unverified
Keep raw pipeline logs separate from knowledge pages
Ask Notion AI to cite source pages explicitly
requires-engineering: add verification gates before downstream summarization

E_compliance.rationale: Airbyte touches business data and has broad egress, while Notion AI is vendor-hosted and sends workspace content to Notion vendor backends and downstream model providers. That combination can create retention or residency mismatches for regulated business content even without PHI. The other agent is cited because the compliance issue arises from their combined data flow, not either one alone.
conditions: IF regulated business data is placed in Notion pages that Airbyte also processes
IF retention or residency requirements differ between the workspace and Airbyte destinations
mitigations: Classify regulated pages and exclude them from AI workflows
Confirm vendor retention settings for Notion AI
Document data-flow boundaries for Airbyte connectors
Use separate tenants for regulated content
requires-engineering: implement residency-aware routing
